bio_en: Artashes Misakian was born in Buyukdere but grew up in Samatia, the most Armenian quarter of Constantinople, and studied at the Sanuts school, developing a passion for Armenian studies. With Suren (Artashes Andreasian) and Shahen (Khachik Gnuni) he formed the revolutionary 'trinity' of Samatia, spreading the ARF's ideas among the best youth of his quarter. An impulsive early step briefly cost him his comrades' trust, but he joined them, with Hayk Arapian, in their final vow. He was killed with them in the Samatia fight of 1896.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Years 1875-1896 from the title; see #567 'The heroic fight of the Samatians'.
